mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad consumer spending contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing sector distress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900 thousand units signal weak residential construction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 900, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.0% consistently correlates with economic distress and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 3-month moving averages signal immediate consumer spending deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST below 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST are both below 3-month moving averages, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.
